"clientScript": {
"css": "\n.ys-btn { cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }\n.ys-btn:hover { background-color: var(--d10184c8-299f-44cc-9cc4-6c157ab82ff9); color: var(--61b9a0dd-bc66-4d7f-8665-a7ecc186a2b9); }\n.ys-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); }\n.ys-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--d9039d0b-819d-46c0-955a-c724d9bf8417); outline-offset: 4px; }\n.ys-btn--primary:hover { background-color: var(--3c44f5ba-3123-4eec-8a2d-22b102237125); color: var(--d10184c8-299f-44cc-9cc4-6c157ab82ff9); }\n.ys-btn--primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--d10184c8-299f-44cc-9cc4-6c157ab82ff9); }\n.ys-btn:disabled, .ys-btn[aria-disabled=\"true\"] { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ys-btn { transition: none; } }\n\n.ys-input { caret-color: var(--d10184c8-299f-44cc-9cc4-6c157ab82ff9); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: -6px; }\n.ys-input:hover { background-color: var(--5c17a78e-b9f8-4df9-92cd-d63edc1c3ecd); }\n.ys-input:focus { box-shadow: none; border-color: var(--d10184c8-299f-44cc-9cc4-6c157ab82ff9); }\n.ys-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--d9039d0b-819d-46c0-955a-c724d9bf8417); outline-offset: -6px; }\n.ys-input[aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: var(--d9039d0b-819d-46c0-955a-c724d9bf8417); }\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ys-input { transition: none; } }\n",
"js": "\nconst live = typeof window !== \"undefined\";\nconst form = this;\nconst field = (name) => form.querySelector('[name=\"' + name + '\"]');\nconst said = form.querySelector(\".ys-form-said\");\nconst helps = { name: form.querySelector(\".ys-help-name\"), phone: form.querySelector(\".ys-help-phone\") };\nObject.keys(helps).forEach((key) => { if (helps[key]) helps[key].textContent = \"\"; });\nif (!live) return;\nform.noValidate = true;\nconst decode = (s) => { const t = document.createElement(\"textarea\"); t.innerHTML = String(s || \"\"); return t.value; };\nconst work = field(\"job\");\nlet typed = false;\nconst cleanups = [];\nconst on = (el, type, fn) => { if (!el) return; el.addEventListener(type, fn); cleanups.push(() => el.removeEventListener(type, fn)); };\non(work, \"input\", () => { typed = work.value.trim().length > 0; });\nconst fill = (detail, focus) => {\n  if (detail && detail.summary && !typed && work) work.value = detail.summary;\n  if (focus) requestAnimationFrame(() => { const first = field(\"name\"); if (first) first.focus({ preventScroll: true }); });\n};\ncleanups.push(window.events.listen(\"estimate:send\", (detail) => fill(detail, true)));\ncleanups.push(window.events.listen(\"estimate:note\", (detail) => fill(detail, false)));\nconst MESSAGES = { name: \"Add your name so we know who to ask for.\", phone: \"Add a phone number so we can call you back.\" };\nconst mark = (name, message) => {\n  const input = field(name);\n  if (message) input.setAttribute(\"aria-invalid\", \"true\");\n  else input.removeAttribute(\"aria-invalid\");\n  if (helps[name]) helps[name].textContent = message || \"\";\n};\n[\"name\", \"phone\"].forEach((name) => on(field(name), \"input\", () => {\n  if (field(name).getAttribute(\"aria-invalid\") === \"true\" && field(name).value.trim()) mark(name, \"\");\n}));\non(form, \"submit\", (event) => {\n  event.preventDefault();\n  let first = null;\n  [\"name\", \"phone\"].forEach((name) => {\n    const bad = !field(name).value.trim();\n    mark(name, bad ? MESSAGES[name] : \"\");\n    if (bad && !first) first = field(name);\n  });\n  if (first) { first.focus(); return; }\n  const v = (name) => ((field(name) || {}).value || \"\").trim();\n  const lines = [\"Name: \" + v(\"name\"), \"Phone: \" + v(\"phone\"), \"Address or ZIP: \" + (v(\"address\") || \"not given\"), \"\", \"What needs doing:\", v(\"job\") || \"not given\"];\n  const text = lines.join(\"\\r\\n\");\n  let href;\n  if (props.send_by === \"text message\") {\n    const raw = String(props.sms_number || \"\");\n    href = \"sms:\" + (raw.trim().startsWith(\"+\") ? \"+\" : \"\") + raw.replace(/\\D/g, \"\") + \"?&body=\" + encodeURIComponent(text);\n  } else {\n    href = \"mailto:\" + decode(props.send_to) + \"?subject=\" + encodeURIComponent(\"Quote request from \" + v(\"name\")) + \"&body=\" + encodeURIComponent(text);\n  }\n  form.dataset.href = href;\n  if (said) said.textContent = decode(props.sent_line);\n  window.location.href = href;\n});\nreturn () => cleanups.forEach((fn) => fn());\n"
},
